description: This is a FastAPI-based backend service code for managing certification jobs, mappings, and metadata. It defines API endpoints for health checks, creating and retrieving certification jobs, managing mappings, and handling metadata. It also includes startup initialization and background task handling.

methods.name: None _background_trigger_orchestration(run_id: str)
methods.description: Placeholder background task to trigger orchestration (e.g., Airflow DAG).

methods.name: None on_startup()
methods.description: Async function to initialize database models on startup.

methods.name: dict health_check_sync()
methods.description: Synchronous endpoint for quick health check.

methods.name: HealthResponse health_check()
methods.description: Async endpoint to check health status including database connectivity.

methods.name: CertificationRunResponse _job_to_response(job: CertificationJob)
methods.description: Helper function to convert CertificationJob object to CertificationRunResponse.

methods.name: CertificationRunResponse create_certification( payload: TriggerCertificationRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Async endpoint to create a new certification job, log it, and trigger background process.

methods.name: CertificationRunResponse get_certification( run_id: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Async endpoint to retrieve a certification job by run_id.

methods.name: CertificationRunResponse patch_certification( run_id: str, payload: PatchCertificationRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Async endpoint to patch an existing certification job and log changes.

methods.name: List[MappingResponse] get_mappings( provider: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by provider"), project_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by project_id"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Async endpoint to list branch-environment mappings with optional filters.

methods.name: MappingResponse post_mapping( payload: MappingItem, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Async endpoint to create a new branch-environment mapping and audit log.

methods.name: List[MetadataItemResponse] get_metadata( key: Optional[str] = Query(default=None), provider: Optional[str] = Query(default=None), project_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None), branch: Optional[str] = Query(default=None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Async endpoint to retrieve metadata items with optional filters.

methods.name: MetadataItemResponse post_metadata( payload: MetadataUpsert, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Async endpoint to upsert a metadata item and log the operation.
